objective: Language models as decision answerers (22.5): asked the generated sets' dev decisions through the decision_answer purpose (the question, the options and the state's bands and name tokens, exactly as a tuned model is trained on them), beside the recorded rule and the classical classifiers, against the benchmark labels.
rule: Dev only: nothing here is a sealed verdict, and nothing a model answered is used. A local model costs nothing; a remote tuned one is asked only under a stated cap. A sealed verdict for a tuned model needs a new generated set: every sealed set of v1 was judged in 22.3.
